title: Zuckerberg's billion-dollar legs
caption:
Billions of dollars into the metaverse, and the avatars still floated like ghosts. 🦿
A VR headset's cameras look outward, so it sees your hands but not your legs, and has to guess where your knees are.
Would you pay for legs in the metaverse?
sources: Meta Connect, 11 October 2022: legs announced for Horizon avatars
Meta statement to UploadVR, October 2022: the legs segment used animations created from motion capture, not live tracking
